post.description: Opens the payment for an unexpired quote against an `ACTIVE` enrollment, whose stored card and owner are used for the charge. The response carries a redirect to a Reap-hosted approval page where the user reviews the order and approves the payment. After approval the user returns to `presentation.returnUrl` and Reap completes the merchant checkout.

schema.description: Unique key for safely retrying this request. Up to 255 characters; we recommend a UUIDv4. The first request executes and its response is cached; subsequent requests with the same key replay the cached response (24h retention).

post.description: Stores a card for later agentic purchases. An existing card is enrolled directly and is `ACTIVE` at once; an `EXTERNAL` source returns a redirect to a hosted card-entry page and becomes `ACTIVE` once the customer submits their card. Pass the enrollment id to `POST /agentic/checkouts` to charge it.
